articles.title: U.S. senators urge Treasury not to leave states out of GENIUS Act stablecoin process
articles.snippet: Senators led by Republican Cynthia Lummis are insisting the Treasury Department ensure states get a process to prove their ability to supervise stablecoins.

articles.title: Hyperliquid loses Anthropic, OpenAI markets as creator shuts down project
articles.snippet: Ventuals, one of the teams behind real-world asset perpetuals on Hyperliquid, said it is closing its markets and joining another project in the ecosystem.

articles.title: Crypto PAC has $12M stake in Senate primary runoff as Alabama voters head to polls
articles.snippet: Defend American Jobs reported spending $7.4 million on media to support Republican Barry Moore ahead of his May 20 Alabama primary, and an additional $4.7 million before Tuesday’s runoffs.

articles.title: Coinbase lets users transfer stock portfolios as exchange expands beyond crypto
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange is deepening its push into traditional finance by enabling ACATS stock transfers and expanding trading products beyond digital assets.

articles.title: ChatGPT Is Still Huge, But Rival AI Chatbots Are Catching Up Fast
articles.snippet: Sensor Tower's State of AI 2026 report shows ChatGPT's audience share slipping below 50% for the first time, as Gemini's default-app advantage and Claude's Pentagon-fueled rally eat into OpenAI's lead.
